title: Lemon Yellow & Green Window Garland
desc: A lush lemon-themed garland framing a window: bright yellow lilies and lemon clusters over light green and blush hydrangeas, tropical taro and monstera leaves, hanging green bean pods and palm fronds, finished with yellow and white fabric bows.

groups.label: Focal Flowers
groups.blurb: Yellow lilies and soft hydrangeas carrying the citrus palette.

items.role: Bright yellow trumpet lilies crowning the garland corners.
Light green hydrangeas forming the main body of the garland.
Blush pink hydrangea clusters softening the lower corner (no yellow-green lisianthus in the library — logged gap; the yellow-green tone is carried by the light green hydrangea and green pods).

groups.label: Citrus & Pods
groups.blurb: The signature lemon elements of this look.

items.role: Yellow berry-cluster branches standing in for the hanging lemon garlands (lemon SKU not in library — follow case-042 mapping #102; form is small round berries, not full-size lemons — noted for Bobbie).
Green bean-pod branches echoing the long hanging pods in the scene.

groups.label: Foliage & Grasses
groups.blurb: Tropical leaves and soft greens framing the window.

items.role: Full-size monstera leaves behind the composition (the scene shows whole leaves, not the cutout style).
Areca palm fronds standing in for the palm leaves (no palm-leaf SKU; feather-palm form matches — noted).
Asparagus fern / ming fern filler greenery (Boston fern itself is logged gap #8).
